evidence.statement: www.theplus-tech.com failed to connect (000) while theplus-tech.com returned 200; typed www traffic was lost. Fixed 2026-08-20, see EV-OWN-009.
No analytics on the owned site: full 118KB source checked for gtag, GTM, google-analytics, Plausible, PostHog, Fathom, Umami, Clarity, Hotjar. None present. Resolved 2026-08-20, see EV-OWN-008.
The owned site has no backend form and no thank-you URL; 16 mailto links are the only capture mechanism. Still true after instrumentation - the click is now measured, but nothing is captured.
Six distinct CTAs and four different offers across README, unpublished page, live site and company-overview.md, against our own Rule of One.

company-overview.md recorded 'Web. www.theplus.tech' but that domain returns 404 on Wix nameservers; the live site is theplus-tech.com. The same dead domain was also the site's metadataBase, so every Open Graph image and canonical resolved against a host serving nothing. Both corrected 2026-08-20.
Outbound was the only channel run to date because it was the only one that worked without measurement; every other channel needs a denominator and a conversion event the surface could not produce.
Production deployed from branch codex/autopsy-preview while main held an abandoned Vite scaffold from 22 May. Any tool assuming main is the site got the wrong answer. Promoted to main 2026-08-20.

Owned site is measured: Vercel Web Analytics live (/_vercel/insights/script.js 404->200 with a control path still 404) and the contact_intent event confirmed end to end in the Vercel dashboard after a real CTA click.
www.theplus-tech.com resolves and 307-redirects to the apex with a valid certificate (CN=www.theplus-tech.com); previously it failed to connect entirely.
Third-party written summary of a creator video on building a digital product business. Figures are creator marketing claims restated by a summariser; no independent verification located.

Meta reports that among creators who posted more after using Trial Reels, 80% saw increased non-follower reach. Meta's own product measurement of a self-selected group, not a general promise of organic reach.
Comment/keyword-triggered DM automation is a real capability, bounded by Meta's interaction and messaging-window rules; unsolicited automated DMs are not permitted.
Gumroad acts as merchant of record and handles applicable sales-tax/VAT collection and remittance, including UK/EU digital-product VAT. Supports commodity-infrastructure-first over building checkout.

4 of 49 EXP-ACQ-0001 sends hard-bounced and never reached anyone: Inology IT (address not found), Central Technology (M365 group rejects external senders), CyberLab (address not found), OryxAlign (550 blocked). A fifth, Texaport, delivered but was auto-logged as service-desk ticket 0095170, where no commercial owner will read it. Effective delivered sample is 45, not 49.
